mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its historical average predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital for equity valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad economic slowdown that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO and HOUST decline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending growth (RSAFS y/y > 0.5%) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as robust consumption supports corporate earnings and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS y/y > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.0%) signals potential monetary tightening that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as stronger labor markets boost consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is rising (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chains that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer and housing demand that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
